messages:
jin: Heads up — spike in mTLS handshake failures out of apac-proxy after the RBAC role surgery yesterday. Seeing a lot of `kms:DecryptDenied` in proxy logs and p95 handshake latency jumped ~300ms. Anyone on rotation? @alana @sre-oncall 

jin: snippet from proxy logs: ```
2025-07-12T11:07:34Z apac-proxy-4 WARN handshake failed remote=10.2.3.45 reason=kms:DecryptDenied key=projects/redwood/keys/edge-keystore role=arn:aws:iam::111:role/keystore-unwrapper-v2
2025-07-12T11:07:34Z apac-proxy-4 WARN fallback check: cached_kv_miss prefix=usr/sessions/kv
```

jala? (typo: meant to ping @alana)

alana: I can see the denies. Audit shows a policy tweak to `keystore-unwrapper-v2` at 2025-07-12T11:02:01Z (whoops). That coincides with the start of errors. Looks like the new policy removed kms:Decrypt on the unwrap resource. Pulling the exact change now.

mike: if that's true, the quick mitigation is to rebind the previous role or add a temporary allow for kms:Decrypt on the keystore key. Also we should TTL-extend any cached session keys so customers don't hit new unwrap paths.

sre-oncall: rolling back the role-binding change now (rbac:role-binding/keystore-unwrapper -> previous). ETA ~3m. Pushing through rollback patch (kubectl apply) to apac-control-plane.

security-bot: detected config change `policy:keystore-unwrapper-v2` by user `infra-deploy-bot` at 2025-07-12T11:02:01Z — attaching diff.

audit-bot: Added tag `incident:tls-unwrap-deny-apac` and pinned audit log: https://audit.internal/logs/7f9c2a5a. Retention 90d.

alana: Confirmed the policy diff — `Condition` block incorrectly scoped to `kms:RequestTag/owner` which our tooling doesn't set for unwrap calls. I'll patch the policy to re-add kms:Decrypt for the keystore resource and remove the overly strict condition. Plan: apply patch, wait for 1m, verify unwrap success rate.

jin: good. Can someone check edge cert TTLs + session-ticket eviction? If sessions drop we could still see customer errors for a while. Command I ran: `kubectl logs apac-proxy-4 | grep Unwrap | tail -n 50` shows ~120 unwrap fails in 2m.

mike: also adding this to short-term mitigations: 1) rebind previous role (in flight), 2) enable local soft-fallback to cached ephemeral keystore for 5m, 3) metric alert on kms:DecryptDenied rate. I'll open ENG ticket for the metric and the fallback change.

alana: rollback applied and policy patched. I'm seeing unwrap success rates return to baseline within 45s. No client-facing errors reported in our incident dashboard so far. :thumbsup:

sre-oncall: Confirming synthetic probes are green for apac region. Marking mitigation complete. ETA to monitor 30m.

jin: capture next steps: create a runbook entry for RBAC -> KMS unwrap, add integration test that validates unwraps when role policy changes, add a guard in the deploy pipeline to warn on removing kms:Decrypt for keystore resources. Filing tickets: #INC-4521 (live triage), #ENG-903 (runbook + tests), #SEC-214 (policy audit).

mike: quick ask for postmortem: can we include a zone-by-zone heatmap of unwrap rates so we can detect policy rollouts sooner? I'll take that on.

alana: I'll follow up with a small policy linter PR to our infra repo that flags suspicious condition scopes on keystore policies.

security-bot: Incident created: INC-4521, responders: jin, alana, mike, sre-oncall.

jin: thanks everyone — great fast response. After monitoring window I'll draft a short blameless postmortem and share in #postmortems. If you see residual handshake spikes drop a note here.

sre-oncall: closing on-call handoff but keeping watch. If anything reappears ping @sre-oncall.```
